metadata.question: Does the rainfall in Somalia decrease during March-September 2022 compared to the 1981-2021 average?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS rainfall data (daily or pentad) - Compare March-September 2022 vs March-September average for 1981-2021 - Location: Somalia boundary 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS data doesn't need cloud masking - it's rainfall data - Just sum precipitation for both periods 3. Logic: - Calculate total rainfall for March-September 2022 - Calculate average total rainfall for March-September 1981-2021 - If 2022 < historical average → Answer A (Yes, decreased) - If 2022 >= historical average → Answer B (No, didn't decrease) - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculation) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Define Somalia geometry const somalia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Somalia')); const geom = somalia.geometry(); // 2. Load CHIRPS rainfall data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // 3. Get 2022 March-September data const rainfall2022 = chirps .filter(ee.Filter.date('2022-03-01', '2022-10-01')) .select('precipitation'); const size2022 = rainfall2022.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images found: ${size2022}`); if (size2022 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2022 period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get historical average (1981-2021, March-September) const rainfallHistorical = chirps .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1981, 2021, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(3, 9, 'month')) .select('precipitation'); const sizeHist = rainfallHistorical.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Historical Images found: ${sizeHist}`); if (sizeHist === 0) { console.log('No historical data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate total rainfall for 2022 const total2022 = rainfall2022.sum(); const result2022 = total2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const rain2022 = result2022.get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Check pixel count const count2022 = total2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Valid Pixels: ${count2022}`); if (count2022 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2022.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Calculate average total for historical period // Sum per year, then average across years const years = ee.List.sequence(1981, 2021); const yearlyTotals = years.map(function(year) { const yearlySum = chirps .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(3, 9, 'month')) .select('precipitation') .sum(); return yearlySum; }); const historicalMean = ee.ImageCollection(yearlyTotals).mean(); const resultHist = historicalMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const rainHist = resultHist.get('precipitation').getInfo(); const countHist = historicalMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Historical Valid Pixels: ${countHist}`); if (countHist === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for historical period.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Validation if (rain2022 === null || rainHist === null || isNaN(rain2022) || isNaN(rainHist) || rain2022 < 0 || rainHist < 0) { console.log('Invalid calculation results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Print results and answer console.log(`2022 Total Rainfall: ${rain2022.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`1981-2021 Avg Rainfall: ${rainHist.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Difference: ${(rain2022 - rainHist).toFixed(2)} mm`); if (rain2022 < rainHist) { console.log('Rainfall decreased in 2022.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Rainfall did not decrease in 2022.'); console.log('B'); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
